string.Description: Connect your business number to receive and reply to customer messages.
string.TokenHint: Leave blank to keep the saved token.
string.Unavailable: Cannot reach the service. Please try again.
string.InvalidParameters: Enter numeric account IDs and an access token.
string.Forbidden: Only workspace owners and administrators can manage this connection.
string.Conflict: This workspace or phone number already has a connection.
string.Failed: Could not save the connection. Please try again.
string.SaveMessageFailed: Could not save the message. Your draft is kept. Please try again.
string.ConnectionRequired: Connect WhatsApp Business in Settings → Integrations to reply.
string.WindowClosed: The customer's last message was more than 24 hours ago. WhatsApp only allows approved template messages now. Once the customer replies, you can type freely again.
string.NeverWrote: This customer has not messaged you yet. WhatsApp only allows an approved template message to start the chat.
string.NoTemplates: No approved templates. Create one in WhatsApp Manager and wait for approval.
string.TemplatesFailed: Could not load templates. Please try again later.
string.InvalidTemplateParameter: Fill in every variable. Variables cannot contain line breaks, tabs or more than 4 spaces in a row.
